_instructions: warn triggers yellow highlight, critical triggers red. null = no threshold in that direction.

Engine Speed._note: Fuel cut at ~6500. Above 6800 = overrev risk (wrong gear)

Coolant Temperature._note: Fans on at 95C. Red warning lamp at ~115C

Engine Load._note: NA engine cannot exceed 100%. >110% = MAF fault or intake leak

Ignition Timing._note: Retard at decel/idle, advance at light load

Knocking Correction._note: FBKC. Single -1.4 OK. -2.8 consistent = warning. -5.0 = bearing damage risk

Learned Ignition Timing._note: Fine Knock Learning. Chronic -2.8 = octane or hardware problem

Battery Voltage._note: <12V = alternator failure. >15V = regulator fault, ECU burn risk

Intake Air Temperature._note: -40 = open circuit sensor. >80 on NA = shorted sensor

Vehicle Speed._note: ECU limiter at ~200-210. >220 = VSS sensor fault

Manifold Absolute Pressure._note: NA: no boost. Hard decel ~15-20 kPa. <5 or >105 = MAP sensor fault

Mass Air Flow._note: EJ253 max WOT approx 130-140 g/s. >170 without turbo = MAF fault

Atmosphere Pressure._note: Sea level ~101 kPa, mountains 70-80 kPa. Extremes = baro sensor fault

Air/Fuel Correction #1._note: STFT bank 1. Transient spikes to 15% OK. ECU sets DTC near +/-25%

Air/Fuel Learning #1._note: LTFT bank 1. >10% from zero = chronic problem (vacuum leak, MAF, injector)

Air/Fuel Sensor #1 Lambda._note: Wideband. <0.70 at WOT = oil film washdown risk. No upper limit (decel fuel cut)

Rear O2 Sensor Voltage._note: Narrowband post-cat. Normal 0.1-0.9V. >1.1V = short to positive

Front O2 Sensor #1 Heater Current._note: Normal 1-3A. <0.1A = heater burned. Very high = electrical fault

Fuel Injection #1 Pulse._note: At 6000 RPM cycle = 20ms. >20ms = injector at 100% duty, lean risk at high RPM

Fuel Tank Pressure._note: EVAP system. FSM specifies sensor limits at +/-6.67 kPa

Oil Temperature._note: Normal 95-105C. >115C = lubrication breakdown. EJ has no oil cooler
